safety_review.findings: Fresh review by a non-author of every reply in all 13 banks, every option, all 3 alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant. Sources opened: NICE NG126 (last updated 17 June 2026), chapter Anti-D immunoglobulin prophylaxis, rec 1.18.1 (no anti-D for ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage up to 11+6 weeks, surgical management included) and 1.18.2 (offer from 12+0 to 12+6 weeks); Srinagarind Med J 2018 abstract (62,201 Khon Kaen donors, Rh(D)-negative 0.2%, Thai range 0.1-0.3%); WikEM summary of the ACOG 2024 Clinical Practice Update (no routine RhIg before 12 weeks for abortion or pregnancy loss, ectopic pregnancy named as a possible exception). WHO MCPC 2017 and the RTCOG CPGs were not reopened; the case review's citations were relied on. Checked: clinical truth, safety, no leak, fit, Thai-English equivalence. No must-fix. step4.B anti_d: the weigh line on Rh-negative rarity is true (0.1-0.3% in Thais) and speaks to yield, not to withholding anti-D from a Rh-negative woman; the other two alternatives support checking her group and giving anti-D in time. The weaker tier matches NICE NG126 1.18.1 and WHO MCPC, but ACOG 2024 leaves ectopic pregnancy open, so it remains a contested case-level call (non-blocking, case issue). Empty safety lines accepted: no option in the tree is an action that could seriously harm her on its own (every step-3 option gives blood and surgery; the step-4 fluid bolus and the step-4.W antipyretic both carry weigh lines that flag the risk). Non-blocking notes: step4.W para could carry a safety line that a new fever with a fast pulse after surgery can signal sepsis or fresh bleeding; step4.R fluid en0/th0 weigh states the cause of her symptoms too firmly (could read likely); step2 fast en0/th0 weigh says free fluid confirms blood (suggests); step2.W glu_lyte th0 weigh uses the Thai for fluid loss where blood loss is meant; step4.B rpt_hb th2 strength reads translated; step4.R fluid en2/th2 strength mentions BP, which variant v2 does not give; step1 e/f weigh lines name blood loss or blood in the abdomen, an inference from vignette signs that names no diagnosis; bold label quotes keep label capitals mid-sentence (Bedside FAST scan, Broad IV, Check Rh); no step-3 reply says surgery does not wait for blood, as the case review asked on #470.
